orchestrator.description: Decomposes the work, reviews components, verifies integration

steps.label: Decompose
steps.description: Break the work into independent components. Define interfaces between them in context/decomposition.md. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Implement
steps.description: Read context/decomposition.md. Build each component to the defined interfaces. Commit per component. Update context/status.md.

steps.label: Integrate
steps.description: Wire components together. Read context/status.md for what was built. End-to-end tests. Fix integration issues. Commit. Update context/status.md.
